ProgramUnit.Name: RETRIEVE_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE retrieve_data IS
 chk boolean;
begin
if :ctrl_block.nick_name is not null
 then 
 set_block_property('name_match',DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'nick_name like '||''''||'%'||:ctrl_block.nick_name||'%' ||'''');

 /*set_block_property('name_match',DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'nick_name = :ctrl_block.nick_name');*/
end if;
if :ctrl_block.first_name is not null
 then
 set_block_property('name_match',DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'first_name like '||''''||'%'||:ctrl_block.first_name||'%' ||'''');

 /*set_block_property('name_match',DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'first_name = :ctrl_block.first_name');*/
end if;
go_block('name_match');

execute_query;
set_block_property('name_match',DEFAULT_WHERE,'');
go_block('name_match');
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_CONTROL_BLOCK_ITEMS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE set_control_block_items(action IN varchar2) IS
BEGIN
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK.NICK_NAME' then
 item_change('ctrl_block.NICK_NAME',action);
 end if;
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK.FIRST_NAME' then
 item_change('ctrl_block.FIRST_NAME', action);
 end if;
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve',action);
 if action = 'E' then
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve',NAVIGABLE,property_false);
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_EFF_TERM_DATES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_eff_term_dates ( eff_date in date,
 term_date in date,
 from_where in varchar2 ) 
IS
dt_chk boolean;
begin
 if eff_date is null then
 show_error('5002');
 end if;
 if eff_date < trunc(sysdate) and from_where = 'E' then
 show_error('5015');
 end if;

 if term_date is not null then
 if term_date < trunc(sysdate) then
 show_error('3115');
 end if;
 dt_chk := check_from_to_date(eff_date,term_date);
 if dt_chk then
 null;
 else
 --message('Err. Term date is before effective date.');
 --raise form_trigger_failure;
 show_error('5004');
 end if;
 end if;
end;

DECLARE

 IF l_error in ('9776','9777') THEN
 show_error(l_error); -- Message Type
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));
 pause;

 exit_form(no_validate);

 :global.chapter_id := l_chp_id;
 :global.user_printer_id := l_print_id;
 END IF;

 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));pause;
 exit_form(no_validate); 
END;
